snippet.title: Have You Herd? - Release Trailer | Out November 24th
snippet.description:
Have YOU Herd? When Woolbeard the baaa-d pirate sheep and the Herdpocalypse descends upon the world, it's up to Cowboy Maloy and his plethora of rescue pups- Duke, Hazel, Rusty, Nugget and Bear- to save it! Bark, Howl, and Herd your way through 20 levels of herding havoc! Go solo and herd alone or team up in co-op mode for 4 players! Can you save the world from the Herdpocalypse and earn everyone their much-needed vacation? Prepare to herd up when Have You Herd? launches on Steam November 24th!

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2209340/Have_You_Herd/
Linktree: https://linktr.ee/TheTideturners
